boss.description: Default orchestrator. Takes any task, asks minimum questions, delegates to the right specialists, drives to completion.

ui.description: Use for ALL UI, frontend, design, styling, layout, component, and visual tasks. Builds award-level non-generic interfaces with crazy animations, effects, and interactions.

backend.description: Use for ALL backend, API, database, auth, server, and infrastructure tasks.

fullstack.description: Use when a task spans BOTH frontend and backend — full feature from DB to UI, end-to-end implementation.

mobile.description: Use for React Native, Expo, and mobile app tasks.

docs.description: Use for writing, editing, and improving documentation, README files, technical writing, API docs, changelogs, blog posts.

testing.description: Use for writing tests, fixing test failures, setting up test infrastructure, improving test coverage, debugging flaky tests.

mcp.description: Use for building MCP servers, tools, resources, and AI agent integrations.

apk.description: Use for Android APK analysis, reverse engineering, mobile security, Android app decompilation.

recon.description: Passive and active asset reconnaissance — subdomain enumeration, DNS records, OSINT, IP range mapping.

auth.description: Test authentication, session management, and authorization.

web-api.description: Map web app routes, API endpoints, trust boundaries, and role/permission matrices.

secrets.description: Hunt for credentials, API keys, tokens, and secrets.

backdoor.description: Find hidden routes, undocumented access paths, and covert channels.

reverse.description: Analyse binaries, executables, libraries, firmware, or source artifacts.

exfil.description: Breach and dump datastores after access is gained.

offensive-operator.description: Develop and execute active exploit chains.

validation.description: Confirm or reject a candidate finding with the smallest reproducible test.

reviewer.description: Independently review and challenge code, architecture, or findings.

source-remediation.description: Trace root causes of bugs or vulnerabilities and write reviewed fixes.

vulnerability-research.description: Research known CVEs and advisories for a specific product and version.
